content.text: I will create the workspace, perform the cleanup and extraction steps, generate fingerprints and summaries, and output the final group count.

arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p group_count_workspace
cd group_count_workspace
cp /etc/group group_raw.txt
orig_lines=$(wc -l < group_raw.txt)
awk ' /^[[:space:]]*($|#)/ {next} {line=$0; gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", line); gsub(/[ \t]*:[ \t]*/, ":", line); print line}' group_raw.txt > group_clean.txt
clean_lines=$(wc -l < group_clean.txt)
removed=$((orig_lines - clean_lines))
echo "$removed" > cleanup_log.txt
awk -F: '{print $1}' group_clean.txt | awk '!seen[$0]++' > group_unique.txt
sha256sum group_unique.txt > group_unique.fingerprint
# verify content consistency between /etc/group and copied file
sha256sum /etc/group > /tmp/etc_group.sha
sha256sum group_raw.txt > /tmp/group_raw.sha
if cmp -s /tmp/etc_group.sha /tmp/group_raw.sha; then consistent="consistent"; else consistent="different"; fi
# readiness summary
echo "/etc/group: $(wc -l < /etc/group)" > ready_for_count.txt
echo "group_raw.txt: $orig_lines" >> ready_for_count.txt
echo "group_clean.txt: $clean_lines" >> ready_for_count.txt
echo "group_unique.txt: $(wc -l < group_unique.txt)" >> ready_for_count.txt
echo "consistency: $consistent" >> ready_for_count.txt
cat group_unique.fingerprint >> ready_for_count.txt
# output the final number of groups
wc -l < group_unique.txt
"}
